Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the search results and conflated OTRAG’s test/launch site in Zaire (now DR Congo) with the company’s actual headquarters. OTRAG was a West German company based in Stuttgart/Neu-Isenburg (Germany). By prematurely asserting DR Congo as the country without verifying authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia article details, reputable aerospace references), the agent introduced the incorrect country attribution that would lead to a wrong conclusion about whether both entities are in the same country.
